evidence.quote: Committee members agreed that substantial additional purchases of longer-term assets eligible for open market operations would be appropriate.
anticipates that economic conditions are likely to warrant exceptionally low levels of the federal funds rate for an extended period.

Overall, most participants viewed downside risks as predominating in the near term
